privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: By visiting the website grill.am (hereinafter referred to as the “Website”) and making purchases, you automatically consent to the collection, processing, and use of your personal data.
introParagraphs: By “Personal Data,” we mean any information that allows or may allow us to directly or indirectly identify your identity, such as your name, surname, address, email, phone number, and other data (hereinafter referred to as “Data”).

In this Privacy Policy, “we,” “us,” and “our” refer to the Website (for more information, please visit the “About Us” section), while “you,” “your,” and “yours” refer to any individual who visits the Website or uses our services.

sections.heading: 1. Collected Data
paragraphs: We may collect the following types of information:
bullets: Contact information – name, surname, address, phone number, email address
Purchase information – products purchased, payment methods
Technical information – device type, browser, operating system
Cookies and tracking technologies – for website usage analysis

sections.heading: 2. Use of Data
paragraphs: Collected data is never sold or provided to third parties for marketing purposes. It is used only for the following purposes:
bullets: Processing and shipping orders
Providing user support
Improving website functionality
Complying with legal requirements

sections.heading: 3. Data Retention Periods
paragraphs: Your personal data is stored as follows:
bullets: User account data – as long as the account is active
Purchase history – 5 years (to comply with tax and accounting regulations)
Marketing data – 2 years or until the user opts out

sections.heading: 4. Data Security
paragraphs: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure the protection of your data, including:
bullets: SSL encryption – to secure payment and personal data transmission
Access control – limited access to personal data
Regular audits – to detect potential security vulnerabilities

sections.heading: 5. Sharing Data with Third Parties
paragraphs: We do not sell or provide your data to third parties, except for:
bullets: Shipping services – to ensure order delivery
Payment systems – for secure payment processing
Law enforcement authorities – in cases required by law
closingParagraphs: All third parties are obligated to protect your data and cannot use it for other purposes.

sections.heading: 6. User Rights
paragraphs: You have the right to:
bullets: Receive a copy of your personal data
Edit or delete your data (through our website settings or customer support)
Opt out of marketing emails (via the “unsubscribe” link in each email)
Request that your data is not processed for specific purposes, except in cases required by law

sections.heading: 7. Cookies Usage
paragraphs: Our website uses cookies to optimize user experience. We use:
bullets: Functional cookies – to ensure proper website operation
Analytical cookies – to understand user behavior and improve the website
Marketing cookies (only with your consent) – to provide more relevant advertisements
closingParagraphs: You can change your preferences at any time by managing cookies in your browser.

sections.heading: 8. Policy Changes
paragraphs: We reserve the right to make legally permitted changes to this page and the above sections. Updates will be posted on the Website.

sections.heading: 6. Payments and Refunds

6.3. If applicable, refund policies will be outlined separately on the Website.

9.2. The Website may collect and process user data for legal purposes.
9.3. The Website reserves the right to disclose user data to authorities as required by law.

refund.title: Return and Refund Policy
refund.intro: Grill.am is committed to ensuring that every order reaches the customer in proper quality and complete condition. Since the products offered on the website are food products, returns and refunds are handled in accordance with food safety and hygiene requirements.

sections.heading: 1. General Return and Exchange Conditions
paragraphs: Food products delivered in proper quality and in accordance with the confirmed order are not eligible for return or exchange.
A return, replacement, or refund may be considered if:
bullets: the delivered item does not match the confirmed order,
one or more ordered items are missing,
the delivered product is damaged, incomplete, or of unsatisfactory quality,
the product or its packaging was damaged during delivery.

sections.heading: 2. Reporting an Issue
paragraphs: Please report any issue as soon as possible after receiving the order. To help us review the case promptly, please provide:
bullets: the order number,
a short description of the issue,
photos of the product and packaging, where possible.
closingParagraphs: Each case is reviewed individually. Where appropriate, Grill.am may offer a replacement, delivery of the missing item, or a full or partial refund.

sections.heading: 3. Refunds
paragraphs: If a refund is approved, it will be issued using the same payment method used for the original purchase.
For card or online payments, the refund may take up to 7 business days, depending on the bank or payment provider procedures.
The delivery fee is refundable only if the issue was caused by Grill.am or the delivery service.

sections.heading: 4. Order Changes or Cancellation
paragraphs: An order may be changed or canceled before preparation begins.
Once preparation has started or the order has been handed over to the delivery service, changing or canceling the order may no longer be possible. Please contact us as soon as possible in such cases.

sections.heading: 5. Non-Returnable or Non-Exchangeable Products
bullets: food products delivered in proper quality and in accordance with the confirmed order,
opened or partially consumed products where no quality issue exists,
products damaged or spoiled due to improper storage by the customer,
custom-made orders that comply with the confirmed order details.

sections.heading: 6. Damaged, Incorrect, or Incomplete Orders
paragraphs: If you receive a damaged, incorrect, or incomplete order, please contact Grill.am immediately. We will review the situation as quickly as possible and offer an appropriate solution.

delivery.title: Delivery Terms
delivery.intro: Grill.am aims to deliver your order quickly, safely, and in proper packaging. The main delivery terms are outlined below.

sections.heading: 1. Delivery Timeframes
bullets: Delivery time depends on the order size, current workload, and delivery address.
Orders are usually delivered within 30–45 minutes.
In case of a possible delay, a Grill.am operator will contact you in advance.

sections.heading: 2. Delivery Arrangements
paragraphs: Order delivery is organized under the following conditions:
bullets: Delivery is carried out by Grill.am or its partner courier services.
The customer must provide a correct address and an active phone number.

sections.heading: 3. Receiving Your Order
bullets: When receiving the order, please check that the items, quantities, and packaging are correct and intact.
If an item is incorrect, missing, damaged, or of inadequate quality, please contact us as soon as possible.

sections.heading: 4. Possible Delays
paragraphs: Despite our efforts, delivery may occasionally be delayed due to:
bullets: Adverse weather conditions
Traffic or transportation issues
Holiday periods or high workload
closingParagraphs: Incorrect or incomplete delivery and contact information may also cause delays. In such cases, we will inform you as soon as possible.
